blocks.text: Is chapter mein students logic (mantiq, yani sahi tarah sochne ke qaide) aur computational thinking ke bunyadi concepts seekhte hain jo computer science mein istemal hote hain. Woh samajhte hain ke masla (problem) saaf aur systematic (tarteeb wale) tareeqe se kaise hal kiya jata hai. Students computational thinking ki techniques dekhte hain, jaise decomposition (bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torna) aur step-by-step (qadam ba qadam) problem solving. Woh propositional logic, truth values (sach ya jhoot ki qeemat), truth tables aur logical equivalence (do baaton ka mantiqi taur par barabar hona) bhi parhte hain.

Chapter satisfiable aur unsatisfiable propositions bhi batata hai (yani aisi baat jo kabhi sach ho sakti hai, aur aisi jo kabhi sach nahi ho sakti) aur faisla karne mein in ka kirdar. Phir students predicate logic, variables aur quantifiers seekhte hain, jin se rishte (relationships) aur shartein (conditions) likhi jati hain. Aakhir mein woh logical reasoning (mantiqi soch) aur inference (diye gaye facts se nateeja nikalna) ki skills banate hain, jo analytical thinking (gehri soch) aur computer science ke aage ke topics ki mazboot bunyad hain.

Computational thinking sochne ka aisa tareeqa hai jis se masle saaf aur mantiqi tareeqe se hal kiye jate hain. Yeh bare masle ko chhote aur aasan hisson mein torne mein madad deta hai. Yeh soch sirf computer science ke students ke liye nahi, sab ke kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Scientists, engineers, balkay chefs (bawarchi) bhi mushkil kaamon ki planning karte waqt computational thinking istemal karte hain.

Computational thinking ka matlab hai problem solver (masla hal karne wale) ki tarah sochna. Is mein masle ko qadam ba qadam samjha jata hai. Hum bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torte hain. Hum maslon aur un ke hal mein patterns (baar baar aane wali milti julti cheezein) dhoondte hain. Hum ghair zaroori tafseel hata kar sirf aham baaton par dhyan dete hain. Phir hum masla hal karne ke saaf steps (qadam) banate hain. Yeh steps insaan bhi follow kar sakte hain aur computer bhi. Computational thinking hamein mantiqi aur saaf sochna sikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar box tarteeb se: 1 bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torein; 2 masail aur hal mein naqsh (patterns) dhoondein; 3 ghair zaroori tafseel hata kar ahem par tawajjuh dein; 4 hal ke wazeh qadam tarteeb se banayein.
blocks.caption: Computational thinking ki chaar aadatein (2.1 ke matan ke mutabiq asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Upar ki chaar aadatein kitab ke paragraph se li gayi hain: (1) bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torna (decomposition), (2) patterns dhoondna, (3) ghair zaroori tafseel hata dena (abstraction), (4) hal ke saaf steps tarteeb se likhna (algorithm). Yeh diagram hamara banaya hua hai, kitab ki figure nahi.

blocks.prompt: Masla hal karne mein computational thinking kyun aham hai? Rozmarra ki ek misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh bare aur uljhe hue masle ko chhote, saaf steps mein badal deti hai, is liye hal dhoondna, check karna aur dobara istemal karna insaan aur computer dono ke liye aasan ho jata hai. Misal: school trip ko chhote kaamon mein baantein (transport, khana, ijazat nama, time table), har saal dohrayi jane wali cheezein dekhein, ghair zaroori tafseel chhor dein, aur tarteeb se checklist likh lein.

items: Computational thinking: masla samjho, chhote hisson mein toro, qadam ba qadam hal karo.
Aadatein: decomposition, patterns, ghair zaroori tafseel hatana (abstraction), saaf steps (algorithm).
Insaan aur computer dono in steps ko follow kar sakte hain; yeh sirf computer science walon ke liye nahi.
